description: Support onboarding workspace for new customers arriving via Freshdesk. Contains the onboarding playbook spreadsheet (steps, customer tiers, run log), three new-customer Freshdesk tickets with contact details, and the CSM directory. ss_playbook.content: Spreadsheet 'ss_playbook' (id ss_playbook). Container for onboarding worksheets: 'ws_onboarding_steps' (the step-by-step onboarding checklist by tier), 'ws_customer_tiers' (tier definitions and entitlements), and 'ws_onboarding_log' (record of completed onboarding runs). Owner: Customer Success Ops. Last updated 2026-05-29.

ws_onboarding_steps.content: Worksheet 'ws_onboarding_steps'. Columns: Step#, Step Name, Applies To Tier, Owner Role, SLA Days. Rows: 1 / Send welcome + account credentials email / All / CSM / 1. 2 / Schedule 60-min kickoff call / All / CSM / 3. 3 / Provision SSO + admin training / Enterprise / TAM / 5. 4 / Collect BAA/HIPAA paperwork / Healthcare-flagged / Compliance / 2. 5 / Post account summary to #cs-onboarding Slack / All / CSM / 1. 6 / Create 30/60/90 success plan / Business, Enterprise / CSM / 7.

ws_customer_tiers.content: Worksheet 'ws_customer_tiers'. Columns: Tier, ARR Threshold, CSM Coverage, Kickoff Format, Cadence. Rows: Starter / < $25k / Pooled CSM / Email only / Quarterly. Business / $25k-$99k / Named CSM / 60-min call / Monthly. Enterprise / >= $100k / Named CSM + TAM / 60-min call + exec readout / Weekly.

ws_onboarding_log.content: Worksheet 'ws_onboarding_log'. Columns: Date, Company, Tier, Assigned CSM, Status. Rows: 2026-05-20 / Birchwood Labs / Business / Maya Singh / Completed. 2026-05-27 / Orion Freight / Enterprise / Derek Holt / Completed. 2026-05-31 / Larkspur Media / Business / Maya Singh / In progress.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_onboarding_tickets
tools.description: Retrieve the open new-customer onboarding tickets from Freshdesk, including subject, requester, plan purchased, and sales notes.

tools.name: freshdesk_lookup_contact
tools.description: Look up the contact details (primary admin, secondary/compliance contacts) attached to a given onboarding ticket.

tools.name: read_onboarding_playbook_steps
tools.description: Read the onboarding step checklist (ws_onboarding_steps) with applicable tier, owner role, and SLA for each step.

tools.name: lookup_customer_tier
tools.description: Read the tier definitions (ws_customer_tiers) to map a customer's ARR to its tier, CSM coverage, kickoff format, and cadence.

tools.name: match_csm_to_accounts
tools.description: Analyze the CSM directory against tier coverage rules and current load to propose which CSM (and TAM/compliance reviewer where needed) should own each new account.

tools.name: draft_onboarding_plan
tools.description: Assemble a draft onboarding plan for each new customer: matched tier, full ordered step list with owners and SLAs, proposed CSM/TAM assignment, and any compliance flags. Saved as a draft for the user to review and approve.

tools.name: gmail_send_onboarding_email
tools.description: Send the welcome / account-credentials onboarding email via Gmail to the customer's primary admin and contacts.

tools.name: calendar_create_kickoff_event
tools.description: Create and send a detailed kickoff-call calendar invitation to the customer and assigned CSM.

tools.name: slack_post_to_csm_channel
tools.description: Post the new-account summary and CSM handoff to the #cs-onboarding Slack channel.

tools.name: read_onboarding_log
tools.description: Read the historical onboarding log (ws_onboarding_log) to see prior runs, assigned CSMs, and statuses for reference.

tools.name: read_cs_directory
tools.description: Look up the Customer Success team directory, including CSM books, current load, specialties, and the team Slack channel for handoffs.

tools.name: read_playbook_spreadsheet_meta
tools.description: Read metadata about the ss_playbook spreadsheet, including which worksheets it contains and when it was last updated.
